breaking_news.headline: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this
breaking_news.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

breaking_news.headline: Americans can't get enough of mahjong. These traditional makers are cashing in
breaking_news.summary: Shoppers in the U.S. are willing to spend hundreds of dollars for a mahjong set. In the eastern Chinese city of Taixing, manufacturers can barely keep up with the demand.

breaking_news.headline: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
breaking_news.summary: Young candidates who rent or live with parents say their generation is "in the thick" of the country's housing affordability crisis. They argue this gives them new energy to solve it for everyone.

breaking_news.headline: Why Meta is charging to post more hyperlinks

breaking_news.headline: A consultant is going viral for exposing the cringe-worthy DMs bosses send employees
breaking_news.summary: A management consultant is going viral after he started sharing cringe-worthy anonymous DMs employees get from bosses. Like, ones they get on their wedding day and worse.

breaking_news.headline: Trade tariffs cause whiplash at Port Milwaukee
breaking_news.summary: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

breaking_news.headline: Netflix lays off 6% of workforce amidst slowing growth
breaking_news.summary: Netflix is regrouping after the release of its latest quarterly earnings this week. Revenue growth at the streaming giant has slowed as the company works to overhaul its programming unit.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
breaking_news.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

breaking_news.headline: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment since 1973
breaking_news.summary: The troops are expected to protect energy facilities in northern Niger, near the Libyan border.

breaking_news.headline: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
breaking_news.summary: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

breaking_news.headline: US Marine indicted for murder and robbery of woman in Japan
breaking_news.summary: Prosecutors have indicted Devin Jacob Ballard for a killing that has caused outrage in Japan, local media reports.

breaking_news.headline: Catholic bishops apologise for 'exploited' Trump meeting
breaking_news.summary: Two bishops in images that show them praying with Trump have said they believed the meeting was private.

breaking_news.headline: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
breaking_news.summary: The R&B star previously pleaded guilty to affray, after attacking a music producer with a glass bottle.

breaking_news.headline: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
breaking_news.summary: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

breaking_news.headline: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
breaking_news.summary: The left-wing incumbent president had lost the first round to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

breaking_news.headline: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
breaking_news.summary: Scotland editor James Cook finds out what life is like on board a ship in an untapped oil field awaiting its fate.

breaking_news.headline: Will a new code end 'rip-off parking charges'?
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister says a new code will end "rip-off parking charges" - but will it work?

breaking_news.headline: Salon owners urge Budget VAT cut as staffing pressures grow
breaking_news.summary: Marcus Perkins, who owns a hair and beauty salon in Brierley Hill, says he is scared for the future.

breaking_news.headline: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
breaking_news.summary: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

breaking_news.headline: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing
breaking_news.summary: Data centres are the lifeblood of our digital world, but there are growing concerns about their environmental impact. The BBC explores their rise in charts.
